author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven

estimand.statement: For grid cell C and frozen obstacle vertical interval Z, OCCUPIED(C) is true iff blocking collision geometry intersects the volume C x Z, where C is the FULL horizontal cell area and not merely its centre point.
estimand.question_asked: does blocking collision geometry intersect this cell volume?
estimand.question_NOT_asked: does something exist at the cell centre?

frozen_parameters.cell_horizontal_extent: [cx - 0.05, cx + 0.05] x [cy - 0.05, cy + 0.05]; cell centres at origin + i*resolution, matching OccupancyGrid's stated convention that origin is the CENTRE of cell (0,0)
frozen_parameters.slab_provenance: the planner obstacle slab already frozen in build_occupancy; unchanged by this tranche

epsilon_convention.rule: no inflation is applied until the known-geometry controls are run at epsilon = 0. If and only if a boundary-tangency false negative is demonstrated, a minimal epsilon may be introduced, fixed before the Hospital rerun, justified numerically, and tested independently.
epsilon_convention.forbidden: inflating the query until a scene passes

frozen_parameters.collision_filtering: any collider PhysX reports for the overlap query is blocking. No name-based or semantic filtering.
frozen_parameters.instance_traversal: the query must resolve colliders from direct prims, referenced assets, USD instances and instance proxies. Plain stage traversal is NOT relied upon; PhysX scene queries operate on the physics scene.
frozen_parameters.touching_cell_boundaries: a face lying exactly on a cell boundary is a boundary-tangency case. Its handling is decided by measurement in the analytic fixtures, recorded, and frozen before production evaluation.

primary_query.kind: PhysX box overlap representing one occupancy cell
primary_query.rationale: the box IS the cell volume; a sphere or a ray answers a different question

rejected_probes_and_why.downward_raycast_from_slab_top: a ray beginning inside a collider reports no hit, so every object taller than the slab vanished. Measured: Geo_W_WallBase10 went from 12.5% of its footprint to 0% while furniture improved, so the aggregate looked better while walls were destroyed.
rejected_probes_and_why.centre_point_overlap_sphere: falls in the empty interior between the shell faces of hollow wall meshes. Measured at Geo_W_WallBase10: overlap_sphere(0.05) at the wall centre returns 0 hits, overlap_sphere(0.20) returns 2.
rejected_probes_and_why.status: both preserved in the evidence ledger; neither is shipped

OBSTACLE_MAP_INTEGRITY_PASS_requires_all: no unexplained blocking-geometry false negatives remain
acceptance_rule.aggregate_rule: scene-wide occupancy improvement is CORROBORATIVE ONLY and can never override a failed causal control

metrics_required.adjudication: false negatives are safety-critical for obstacle rasterisation and require explicit adjudication; they may not be averaged away

claim_boundaries: Correctness of a simulated obstacle map is not physical-robot validation.
No route is admitted and no data is collected by this tranche.
unchanged_by_this_tranche: the frozen Hospital and Office route-set results
